title: YouTube AdFree (Universal Web v0.8.4)
appDescription: Working Universal Web release (v0.8.4) for LG webOS 3.0-6.0 (55UP77006LB). Includes AdBlock, SponsorBlock with skipped-duration display, webOS 6 Spatial Navigation Polyfill speedups, Max Thumbnail Quality (Fast/Original), and YouTube TV UI fixes.
